release_notes:
1. Accurate Add-to-Cart Quantity: Captures multi-quantity additions (e.g. 2 units) via CartController HTTP request and ps_cart_product state with zero DOM querying.
2. Variant Object Sanitization: Formats combination descriptors cleanly and eliminates [object Object] leaks.
3. Category Name Parity: Standardizes canonical display category (Baby Geschirr) across view_item and add_to_cart.
4. Resilient 1-Click Update: Eliminates 500 error in Module Manager by routing through authenticated AdminModules controller.
